articles.title: U.S. Senate Democrats tell CFTC to back off its demand prediction markets defy bans
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission directed platforms such as Kalshi to defy state bans, but the Democrats want it to reverse course, citing court orders.

articles.title: Trump administration to name Nvidia, OpenAI and several others as AI national champions
articles.snippet: The Wall Street Journal reported that the move aims to help the firms expand overseas and compete with global rivals, though nothing has been confirmed.

articles.title: Safe wallet reportedly loses $6.5M as Zodiac suspects key compromise
articles.snippet: Zodiac’s co-founder said a likely compromised key and overly permissive wallet settings enabled the theft, rather than a flaw in its smart contracts.

articles.title: Hackers Redirected Bitcoin Miner Rewards via AI Attack, Luxor CEO Says
articles.snippet: Luxor said hackers redirected hashrate from just over a dozen client accounts through its Commander tool, and its CEO blamed a “sophisticated AI-enabled vector.”

articles.title: Fed Is Modeling AI 'Super Intelligence' Scenarios, Including Job Losses and a Stock Market Slump
articles.snippet: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh says staff are studying three possible economic futures for AI, ranging from widespread productivity gains to higher unemployment and a painful correction in technology stocks.
